reasons: Nova Scotia law with Nova Scotia courts is the vendor's home jurisdiction and outside the accepted set (NY, DE, CA, England & Wales), so it fails both the preferred and fallback positions — deviation is correctly classified.

The redline swaps only the jurisdiction and forum wording to New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, preserving the sentence structure; the elevated changed-character ratio is inherent to replacing the governing-law and venue words and is acceptable here.
Moving from non-exclusive to exclusive jurisdiction tracks the playbook's preferred position and does not overreach.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, states what changed and why, and offers the Delaware/California/England & Wales fallback.
